positions.title: Accountant Auditor II
positions.locationName: Santa Ana, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•  Performed the accounting and finances across county programs including public health initiatives (e.g., HIV testing, zika virus response, breast cancer screening) to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
•  Analyzed expenditures and prepared audit documentation for grant-funded programs to verify allowable use of funds and adherence to budget guidelines.
•  Procurement processing for law enforcement equipment purchases for the Orange County Sheriff's Department, ensuring proper use of public funds and contract compliance.
